videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Assane hatches a plot to contact Comet, an inmate who steers him to a clue about Babakar's demise. Anne Pellegrini comes clean about the past.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Assane confronts Commissioner Dumont and plants a decoy to divert the police. Hubert Pellegrini's connection to Babakar's fate comes to light.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: To retrieve incriminating evidence on Hubert, Assane enlists the help of a journalist. Officer Guédira connects the dots around the Louvre heist.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: En route to Étretat with Claire and Raoul, Assane encounters an unwelcome figure. In a bind, Assane sends a message to Capt. Laugier.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Assane searches for Raoul with Guédira in tow. In a deserted Normandy mansion, a heated confrontation erupts between Leonard and Assane.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Hubert makes a deal with Dumont and sets a trap for Assane, who's one step ahead. Claire knocks on Hubert's door.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: As he attempts to gain Juliette's trust with a series of capers, Assane devises an elaborate plot that would blindside Hubert.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Leonard tails Assane to his home. Hubert orchestrates a frame-up. Assane leaves a clue online for Guédira that sheds light on Dumont.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: In a scheme to usurp all schemes, Assane and Benjamin recruit and disguise a clever accomplice in order to bring Hubert to justice.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: To mend matters with Claire and Raoul, Assane devises a plan to get them out of France. But with high stakes come greater risks — and no room for error.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: An unfathomable loss rocks France, but Guédira and Raoul grapple with denial. A mysterious classified ad resurrects old ghosts and long-lost hopes.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: As Fleur and Guédira strike a deal, Belkacem visits Benjamin. Assane tries to outmaneuver a new enemy in the shadows while keeping tabs on his family.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Assane meets his mother's captor in the flesh, but there's no sign of her. Tasked with another all-or-nothing heist, he makes a devastating choice.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Increasingly suspicious, Claire launches an investigation of her own. Guédira gets the surprise — and opportunity — of a literature lover's lifetime.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Having identified his opponent, Assane races to protect his family and avoid retaliation. Belkacem remains wary of Guédira; Mariama sends a message.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: A family reunion years in the making comes to pass. With Mariama's help, Assane makes a final play to stop Keller, right his wrongs and go out in style.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: After four years in prison, Assane is days away from early release and a new life with Raoul – until a mysterious cyberattack threatens it all.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: A furious Guédira vows to take Lupin down as Assane comes face to face with his copycat, whose high-risk offer lures him to a heist at the Eiffel Tower.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Assane proclaims his innocence as Raoul lands in his own set of troubles, forcing his dad to join forces with unexpected allies to capture the copycat.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: As police prepare to take Adèle back to London, Raoul's long-awaited trip with his dad hits a last-minute snag. Ben and Assane concoct a daring scheme.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Vowing to go after the Guardians of the Treasure, Adèle and Assane set their sights on Les Invalides. Meanwhile, Raoul also puts his skills to use.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Assane awakes to an ominous figure from his past. Compelled to tell the truth, he hatches a death-defying plan. Esteban finds Raoul's new place of work.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: As Raoul embarks on his own journey, Assane and Adèle retrace old steps with new technology to find the treasure – with Korvin hot on their trail.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Assane and the gang attempt to lure the treasure out of the fortress. But can they outrun the police, the Guardians and all the chaos they've caused?
